title: Preservation of a natural segment
statement: Let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of natural numbers. Suppose that for every index $i<|l|$, $\mu(a+i)$ equals the integer represented by $l_i$. If $\mu'(b)=\mu(b)$ for every $b$ with $a\le b<a+|l|$, then for every $i<|l|$, $\mu'(a+i)$ equals the integer represented by $l_i$.
hypotheses_covered: A list l of natural numbers
The function μ agrees with the integer cast of l at every index in the segment starting at a
The functions μ and μ' agree at every index b with a ≤ b < a + |l|
